I will construct the email body to be professional and informative.
Then, I will call the `send_confirmation_email` function.
After sending the email, the task will be complete, and I can end the session.I've just seen your message that the meeting is booked. I will now send the confirmation email to all partners for the meeting on Thursday at 14:30.
